title: sarif-to-comment diagnostic, version 1
description: A diagnostic of sarif-to-comment, as every library outcome and CLI JSON or TOON document carries it in `diagnostics`, and a problem as `problems` arrays carry it. Version 1 is fixed: a change to the fields is a new schema file. Codes are listed in docs/diagnostics.md.

severity.description: error: the operation did not do what was asked. warning: it did, or may have, and something needs attention. note: information only.

code.description: A stable, kebab-case code from the catalog.

location.description: Where the diagnostic is: a JSON Pointer into the SARIF document, and/or a repository-relative path with one-based lines.

title.description: One plain-text line, the same for every diagnostic of the code.

subject.description: What the diagnostic concerns when that is not a location.

problem.description: A diagnostic as a problems array carries it: the diagnostic fields plus the flat pointer and path 0.2.x problems always had.
